description: Add the FaultForge MCP server (local stdio, /home/mikep/projects/fault-forge, branch feature/mcp at d469b9f) so concurrency invariants can be proven under real k6 load in a sealed, network-free Docker sandbox. Scope this bead: .mcp.json at the repo root; verify faultforge_status and faultforge_list_scenarios(project_dir=/home/mikep/projects/jade). No faultforge.yaml or stack.yaml yet: FaultForge cannot build a SvelteKit + Postgres app from source until its M11. Dev tool only: it adds load checks next to JADE's own tests (ADR 0015 k6 stays the load tool for jade-0d8) and never replaces them. Test data is the demo kit only, in a throwaway sandbox DB; no real kit codes, children's data or IPs in any FaultForge config.
notes: Decision: .mcp.json written at the repo root but NOT committed. It names an absolute path to Mike's local fault-forge checkout, which breaks on any other machine and in CI, so it is excluded via .git/info/exclude (local, uncommitted). No ADR conflict: ADR 0015's k6 stays the load tool (jade-0d8); FaultForge is an added dev check. No planloop: one local tool config file, no app code, migration, route or risk domain. Follow-ups jade-4el, jade-bnk, jade-0nf each blocked on their feature bead and on jade-cdw (FaultForge M11).
title: Wire FaultForge MCP server for concurrency invariant tests
